title: Road Blazer: Mobile Car Game
description: A mobile car racing game built with Flutter and Dart, tested on an Android emulator.
details: Road Blazer is a car racing game for phones with a moving road, a score and a high score. I built it in Flutter and ran it on an Android emulator while developing. [Add your role, a challenge you solved, and what you learned.]

title: Milkshake Ordering System
description: A Java desktop ordering system for a milkshake shop that counts orders and computes the total, cash and change.
details: A point-of-sale style app with 9 milkshake flavors. Each item has a quantity counter, and the app shows the total, takes the cash amount, computes the balance and makes a receipt. [Add your role, a challenge you solved, and what you learned.]
